name: Obidos
source: Agencia Nacional de Aguas e Saneamento Basico (ANA), HidroWeb web service
datum: cm above the staff gauge zero installed 22 Feb 1968, 8.144 m below CPRM benchmark RN4 (Callede, Guyot et al. 1996)
license: No license on the HidroWeb service itself. The SNIRH metadata record for the national hydrometric network allows reproduction of the data provided the source is cited (https://metadados.snirh.gov.br/geonetwork/srv/api/records/f85dbf06-a869-414c-afc5-bb01869e9156). Credit: Agencia Nacional de Aguas e Saneamento Basico (ANA), HidroWeb.
notes: Datum check: 424 days where both the historic series and telemetry have a value (2025-01-01 to 2026-02-28); telemetry daily mean minus historic value: median +0.2 cm, mean +0.2 cm, 5th-95th percentile -1.9 to +2.1 cm. A median near zero means the two share the same gauge zero.

Historic series: ANA HidroSerieHistorica, tipoDados=1 (stage). Where a month exists at consistency level 2 (consistent, reviewed by ANA) we use it; otherwise level 1 (raw) and mark it provisional. Last level-2 date: 2023-12-31. Level-1 days used: 790.

Per-day status codes from ANA (CotaNNStatus): 118 days flagged 2 'estimated' are marked estimated; 0 days flagged 3 'doubtful' and 0 days flagged 4 'dry staff gauge' are kept as published with their consistency-level quality.

Daily value: ANA's daily-mean row where published (normally the mean of the 07:00 and 17:00 staff readings); otherwise the mean of the reading rows for that day. Days by source row: {'daily_mean_row': 20827}.

Historic record ends 2026-02-28. Days after that come from the ANA telemetry feed (DadosHidrometeorologicos, mostly 15-minute readings), averaged to a daily mean (229 days, marked provisional). Telemetry days with fewer than 12 readings: 4.
No fill values found in this series; ANA leaves missing days blank.

measurement_history.fact: An earlier staff gauge on the port pier was read daily 1927-1947 and in mid-1948; it was never tied to a benchmark and was destroyed by the 1953 flood. That older series is not in this file and does not share the current zero (likely 77 cm higher).
The current staff gauge was installed on a new pier on 22 Feb 1968. Its zero is 8.144 m below CPRM benchmark RN4. Daily readings have no gaps except 1969, which is missing.

An automatic recorder was installed a few km upstream in 1982, tied to the port gauge (its readings need an 11 cm reduction, and its well runs dry at low water). Satellite telemetry was added in 1985.
ANA inventory: recorder 1982-01-01 to 2013-09-01, telemetry from 1997-05-01.
Not found: number and hour of daily readings.

public_notes: This record starts in 1968 and has no data for 1969. An older gauge from 1927 to 1948 used a different zero, so it is left out. Values after 2023 are not yet reviewed.
